_doc: v3 settings for the fueltruck (LANCE-19): rigid vehicle, moving parts split out by tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py from fueltruck_prep.json (work dir fueltruck_tracks), fit from tools/art/v3/fueltruck_veh.json via v3_rigid.py.
name: fueltruck

source.title: Fuel Truck
source.author: RGriffin65
source.notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 2, 2026-10-30), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. WHEELED: the kit has 3 axles (6 wheels), MC2's fuel truck 4. The 6 wheels (`wheel_l0`..`wheel_r2`) are OWN GEOMETRY (`make_wheel`: tyre drum, recessed rim, hub boss, bolts) on axles fitted to the kit's wheels, which were cut from the hull; the front pair is under `steer_l0`/`steer_r0` pivots. This own geometry is part of the CC BY-SA 4.0 derivative. No turret or gun (the kit and the original have none). Welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 8 degrees, no collapse.
